title: Discord messages become cat comics
summary:
A community-heavy day brought cat comics to Discord, animated floors to Sirius Elevator, and more apps to explore.

CatGPT was added as a Discord bot that turns messages in a configured channel into black-and-white cat webcomics. Claude writes a short, sarcastic reply; nanobanana draws the comic using the sender’s avatar as a reference for the human character.

Sirius Cybernetics Elevator gained floor-specific Lottie backgrounds for floors 1–5, PNG alternatives, a floor indicator, and a persistent animation toggle. Follow-up sizing changes adapt the backgrounds for embedded and standalone views.

The community catalog added an Arabic-language recipe-image app, labol lens, two games, and vocamax, an Android vocabulary app that uses Pollinations for images and learning support.
